Scouts watch every match at an event and record how each robot performs. That data drives our match strategy and our alliance pick list.

  • Learn the current game rules and scoring first.
  • Practice scouting on match videos before your first event.
  • Stay focused on one robot per match and record what actually happened, not what you expected.

blocks.html:
Before each match, the strategy lead briefs the drive team using our data:

  • What each partner and opponent robot does best.
  • Who plays which role in auto and teleop.
  • What the opponents are likely to do, and how we counter it.

1. Rank teams by the data first, using averages and consistency, not one great match.
  2. Add qualitative notes: driving, reliability, defense.
  3. Pick robots that complement ours rather than copy it.
  4. Keep a backup list in case top choices are taken.
